title: CREDA Governance Response Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for representing a machine-readable governance response produced by a CREDA implementation.

response_id.description: Unique identifier for the governance response.

request_id.description: Identifier for the governance request that produced this response.

outcome.description: Simplified public reference outcome vocabulary. This vocabulary is non-normative.

decision_reference.description: Optional reference to a decision artifact or implementation-defined decision record.

authority_state_reference.description: Optional reference to authority-related state associated with the evaluation.

evaluation_context_reference.description: Optional reference to the policy, ruleset, or evaluation context used.

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp at which the governance response was produced.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp after which the response should not be relied upon without reevaluation.

integrity_reference.description: Optional implementation-defined integrity or provenance reference.

execution_reference.description: Optional reference to a downstream transaction, receipt, execution, or external system record.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative governance semantics.
